fields.design:
PCSCR-774 (Tayla Davies):
As Below: Please have the sequence box set up like this:
[Image in form – see source document] (sequence box layout)

'TARP change PCSCR.docx' (James Brooks draft, also numbered 774):
1. CV-005 setpoint to 530tph - Maintain Bin Inventory Between 110-120%
2. Put FE-10 to manual and turn stop
3. Allow PU-009 to flush for allocated time 10 to 15 min
4. Put PU-009 pressure PiD loop to manual at current speed
5. Manual close HP-001 make up water 222-LIC-8173
6. Allow HP-001 level to reduce below 10% ready for pump change
7. Line PU-010 to HMS bypass Dewatering cyclone 231-CY-514
8. Open gland water valve 222 Change -XV-8176 to PU-010
9. Close Drain valve to PU-010 222-XV-8191
10. Open suction valve to Pu-010 222-XV-8190
11. Stop PU-009
12. Change duty pump from PU-009 to PU-010
13. Start PU-010 at a manual CV of 90%
14. Manual close Make up to HP-301 223-LIC-1526
15. Slow down Pump PU-301 to 45 %
16. Decrease Ball mill feed water to 15 m3/h
17. Increase Ball mill discharge pump speed to 98%
18. Possibly look at GDC and FDC automated opening and closing depending on hopper levels
19. Put HP-001 make up water 222-LIC-8173 back into Auto
20. Stabilise Hooper levels and flows pressures etc
21. Close PU-009 Suction valve 222-XV-8180
22. Open PU-009 Drain valve 222-XV-8181
23. Restart 222-FE-010 with a reduced CV around 20 to 25 %
Please note that this can also be done when changing from 222-PU-509 to 222-PU-510, using the same procedure.
fields.impact: TARP A→B changeover runs as a sequence rather than ~23 manual CRO steps.
